(2) A medium shot captures the toddler standing in the center of the room. Behind her is a spacious living area with a light-colored sofa, a white beanbag chair, and a play area with toys and a small slide. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from a window in the background. (3) The camera moves to a close-up of the toddler's face as an adult's hand gently strokes her hair and forehead. The toddler looks at the camera with a curious and slightly sleepy expression. (4) The toddler is then seen lying on the light wood floor, laughing and rolling around. She interacts with someone off-camera, possibly her mother, whose hands occasionally enter the frame. (5) Another young girl, slightly older and wearing a purple shirt, joins the toddler on the floor. They both lie down, looking towards the camera and smiling. The setting is the same indoor home environment. (6) The toddler sits up on the floor in front of light-colored wooden cabinets. She covers her mouth with both hands while giggling, showing a shy but happy expression. (7) A final close-up focuses on the toddler as she looks directly into the lens and sings. Her facial expressions are animated and joyful. The video ends with a pink graphic screen featuring an animated version of the girl and branding text.
